trial_court: V Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Bengaluru, M.C. No. 56/2016
case_name: Sri. Bhaskar. N. D. vs Smt. Anitha Lakshmi. B. H.

parties.respondent_defendant: Smt. Anitha Lakshmi B. H., wife

facts_of_case: Petitioner filed M.C.No.56/2016 seeking a decree of nullity under Section 12(1)(a) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. Respondent sought interim maintenance and litigation expenses. Family Court granted Rs.5,000/- per month as interim maintenance and Rs.20,000/- towards litigation expenses.

legal_principles.principle: The quantum of maintenance awarded to the respondent is on the higher side.
legal_principles.held: She submitted that petitioner has other financial commitments and the award of Rs.5,000/- per month as interim maintenance to the respondent is exorbitant.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the respondent to prove her claim for interim maintenance.
legal_principles.held: Although, she claimed Rs.20,000/- per month as interim maintenance and Rs.50,000/- as litigation expenses, the Family Court on considering the income and other financial commitments of petitioner has ordered only Rs.5,000/- per month as the interim maintenance and Rs.20,000/- towards litigation expenses.

outcome.final_order: The impugned order dated 02.02.2018 was not interfered with by the High Court.
